# Molecule Optimization

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## Fragment-Based Optimization

Optimize a reference molecule using fragments derived from an uploaded SMILES library. This is distinct from the removed Fragment-Based Generation workflow.

Exact job name: `Fragment_Based_Optimization`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref_mol` | string | yes | value | Validated reference molecule SMILES. Screenshot text is not a default. |
| `library_path` | string | yes | file | Upload a CSV with a `SMILES` header and use the returned platform storage path. |
| `global_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Selected model objects with name, min_threshold and max_threshold; preserve user-supplied bounds and documented empty bounds. |
| `custom_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Optional custom property models in `{id, min_threshold, max_threshold}` form. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## Lead Generation — Augmented

Lead Generation — Augmented

Exact job name: `Lead_Generation_Augmented`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Default: `"smiles_aug_mem"` |
| `no_of_molecules` | integer | yes | value | Number of molecules |
| `steps` | integer | yes | value | Number of steps |
| `data_path` | string | no / mode-dependent | file | S3 path to CSV (upload first) |
| `name` | string | yes | value | Experiment name |
| `dataType` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Type of models tobe used; preserve the exact documented choices. |
| `global_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Optional selected model objects with name and numeric min_threshold/max_threshold. |
| `custom_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Selected custom models using the documented object fields below; use authorized model identifiers. |
| `finetune` | string | yes | value | if true, required data_path (or) if false, no finetuned model will be returned |
| `model_path` | string | no / mode-dependent | artifact | Authorized existing fine-tuned platform model reference; required for dataType CMD. Not a local executable-model upload. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## Lead Generation — Reinvent

Lead Generation — Reinvent

Exact job name: `Lead_Generation_Reinvent`.

### Inputs
